arxiv-2206-11341.title: Stagewise Newton Method for Dynamic Game Control with Imperfect State Observation
arxiv-2206-11341.creator: Armand Jordana, Bilal Hammoud, Justin Carpentier, Ludovic Righetti
arxiv-2206-11341.description: Abstract In this letter, we study dynamic game optimal control with imperfect state observations and introduce an iterative method to find a local Nash equilibrium. The algorithm consists of an iterative procedure combining a backward recursion similar to minimax differential dynamic programming and a forward recursion resembling a risk-sensitive Kalman smoother.

arxiv-2210-05532.title: Flow-oriented perturbation theory Preprint: Nikhef 2022-017 IPARCOS-UCM-23-005
arxiv-2210-05532.creator: Michael Borinsky, Zeno Capatti, Eric Laenen, Alexandre Salas-Bernárdez
arxiv-2210-05532.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Michael Borinsky, Zeno Capatti, Eric Laenen, Alexandre Salas-Bernárdez. We introduce a new diagrammatic approach to perturbative quantum field theory, which we call flow-oriented perturbation theory (FOPT). Within it, Feynman graphs are replaced by strongly connected directed graphs (digraphs). FOPT is a coordinate space analogue of time-ordered perturbation theory and loop-tree duality, but it has the advantage of having combinatorial and canonical Feynman rules, combined with a simplified i ​ ε i\varepsilon dependence of the resulting integrals.

arxiv-2509-07391.title: Existence and stability of the Riemann solutions for a non-symmetric Keyfitz–Kranzer type model
arxiv-2509-07391.creator: Rahul Barthwal, Christian Rohde, Anupam Sen
arxiv-2509-07391.description: Abstract In this article, we develop a new hyperbolic model governing the first-order dynamics of a thin film flow under the influence of gravity and solute transport. The obtained system turns out to be a non-symmetric Keyfitz-Kranzer type system. We find an entire class of convex entropies in the regions where the system remains strictly hyperbolic.

arxiv-2601-16088.title: Carrier envelope phase and pulse shape effects on vacuum pair production in asymmetric electric fields with bell-shaped envelopes
arxiv-2601-16088.creator: Abhinav Jangir, Anees Ahmed
arxiv-2601-16088.description: A 2026 arXiv research paper by Abhinav Jangir, Anees Ahmed. We investigate the combined effects of carrier envelope phase and laser pulse shape on electron-positron pair production in the presence of an external time-dependent asymmetric electric field by solving the quantum Vlasov equation. We analyze how the pulse asymmetry, the envelope type (Gaussian, Lorentzian and Sauter), and the carrier envelope phase jointly influence the momentum distribution and the number density of created pairs.

pmc-10696795.title: Analysis of hemi-uterus pregnancy outcomes in uterine malformations: a retrospective observational study
pmc-10696795.creator: Liang Qian, Jiashan Ding, Lan Shi, Qing Yu, Jiawei Zhu, Anfeng Huang
pmc-10696795.description: BackgroundThe association between uterine malformations and adverse pregnancy outcomes is well recognized. However, studies on adverse pregnancy outcomes based on one kind of anatomical commonality between different uterine anomalies have not been reported. This study aimed to investigate pregnancy outcomes in pregnancies with uterine malformations when the pregnancy is confined to a hemi-uterus.

pmc-11388149.title: Disentangling the Web: An Interdisciplinary Review on the Potential and Feasibility of Spider Silk Bioproduction
pmc-11388149.creator: Ghita Guessous, Lauren Blake, Anthony Bui, Yelim Woo, Gabriel Manzanarez
pmc-11388149.description: The remarkable material properties of spider silk, such as its high toughness and tensile strength combined with its low density, make it a highly sought-after material with myriad applications. In addition, the biological nature of spider silk makes it a promising, potentially sustainable alternative to many toxic or petrochemical-derived materials.

pmc-11516423.creator: N Sturm, S Kretschy, N Prauhart, R Hofmann, D Stelzhammer, S Tacha, T Hirsch
pmc-11516423.description: BackgroundThe COVID-19-crisis has posed major challenges for organisations providing care in terms of fulfilling their contracts as well as maintaining their quality standards. pmc-13312849.description: IntroductionHypogonadotropic hypogonadism (HH), or secondary gonadal dysfunction, is a result of gonadal failure due to deficiencies in gonadotropin secretion, caused by hypothalamic or anterior pituitary dysfunction. uslaw-usc-t50-s3382.title: 50 U.S.C. § 3382 — Director of the National Counterintelligence and Security Center
uslaw-usc-t50-s3382.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t50-s3382.description: United States Code, Title 50 (War And National Defense); Chapter 45 (Miscellaneous Intelligence Community Authorities); Subchapter V (Management Of Counterintelligence Activities). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. (a) Establishment There shall be a Director of the National Counterintelligence and Security Center (referred to in this section as the “Director”), who shall be appointed by the President, by and with the advice and consent.
